abilities.name: Aisa Utamakura Pilgrimage
abilities.caveat: In game the stance blocks Normal and Charged Attacks; typing N or C still shows a block on the timeline, so sequence valid actions yourself.
_curatorNotes: Dreamdrifter is the Nightsoul state for Mizuki — opensState: "nightsoulBlessing" + behavior: "stance" opens both inStance and nightsoulBlessing for the 5s window. terminatesOnSwap: true matches gcsim's OnCharacterSwap handler that calls cancelDreamDrifterState.

Re-pressing E during Dreamdrifter cancels the state in 1 frame; the parser's current model can't distinguish 'second E exits' from 'second E starts new stance' — the latter is what would happen, which is wrong but acceptable for v1.
Drift cloud emits Cryo-tagged-no-actually-Anemo damage every ~0.75s (cloudHitInterval=45, cloudFirstHit=18) for the stance duration. P3 (Summon.effects[]) gap — flag and migrate when proposal lands.

↻ 2026-08-18: the P3 "Summon.effects[] gap" the note above asks for was RESOLVED, in a different shape — the drift cloud is authored as this ability's own `application[]` (8 anemo entries: frame 2 for the cast's AoE, then 45f apart = the gcsim cloudHitInterval), so the cloud's ELEMENT reaches the gauge and its swirls drive the A1 extension below. ⛔ Do not migrate it to `summons[]`: a summon means a thing LEFT IN THE WORLD, and Dreamdrifter is a stance whose span the E bar already draws. What genuinely remains unauthored is the cloud's DAMAGE cadence (no summon lane row, no tick marks) — that is the only half of this note still open.

A1 Bright Moon's Restless Voice authored 2026-05-10 (E3 v1.5): durationExtensions[] on the skill (Dreamdrifter stance), trigger onReaction swirl, +2.5s per fire, max 2, 0.3s ICD. ↻ 2026-08-18: the under-fire warning that used to close this note is RETIRED and all three of its clauses are dead. It read "parser cast-only emission fires swirl on E and Q anemo casts; drift-cloud ticks and per-N anemo aren't modeled … pure-E or zero-Q rotations under-fire by 50%". Today reactions come OUT OF A REAL GAUGE rather than being assumed at the cast (sim/aura.ts `offerApplication` → `emitReaction` → `dispatchOnReactionExtensions`); the drift-cloud hits ARE modelled, as this ability's `application[]` entries; and N/C/P swings apply in their own right. The extension fires off whichever of those applications actually swirls, under the cast's own ICD clock (standard 150f/every-3, so three of the eight cloud entries apply) — enough for both +2.5s fires whenever a swirlable aura is up, and correctly ZERO fires when the enemy carries none. ⚠️ The one bound that survives: only the character who CAUSED a reaction extends their own window (dispatchOnReactionExtensions is keyed to `src.characterId`), so a teammate's swirl inside Dreamdrifter never extends it — which MATCHES this kit ("when Yumemizuki Mizuki triggers Swirl") and is therefore not a divergence for her, unlike Collei's zone where it is one.

↻ AUTHORED 2026-09-16 (T0.5) — and the blocker this note used to state was STALE. It read "gcsim adds it via AddReactBonusMod which we don't have a primitive for"; the 7.0 round minted exactly that primitive, because bucket-5 `*ReactionBonus` IS AddReactBonusMod. What was missing was a family-wide `swirlReactionBonus` Stat member, added in the same commit on the `stellarGlimmerReactionBonus` precedent — gcsim returns ONE number from a single switch arm over the four AttackTagSwirl* tags (skill.go:149-154), and the official talent row is likewise one row, "Elemental Mastery-Based Swirl DMG Increase". ⛔ It does not replace the per-flavour members: Diona's C6 names Cryo Swirl alone.

Values: swirlDMG[10] = 0.45 and gcsim computes `swirlDMG * EM * 0.01`, i.e. 0.45% per EM point = ratio 45 (⚓ `ratio` is per 100 STAT UNITS), which is the sidecar's "0.45% per Point" row verbatim. The Stellar half is stellarSwirlDMG[10] = 0.045 through the identical formula, so ratio 4.5 — a tenth of the base, authored as its own effect because it is its own Stat and its own reaction. ⚠️ The window is the stance's base 5s; the A1 extension (+2.5s ×2 per Swirl) moves the STANCE and not a buff window, the same split recorded on Cyno's burst EM this day.

⛔ Still not modeled here: the cloud runs on the WRONG ICD. gcsim gives it ICDGroupMizukiSkill (72f timer, sequence {1,0,0,0}) and the activation hit ICDTagNone, while all 8 `application[]` entries go through our standard 150f/every-3 cast counter — measured `Mizuki E Q` at C0 applies at f2/138/183/318 where gcsim applies at f2/48/138/228/318. The `IcdWindow` shape exists (summonTick.icdGate, chargedIcdWindow) but has no home on a cast's application[]; schema + engine.
abilities.description:
Weaves memories of lovely dreams, entering a Dreamdrifter state where Yumemizuki Mizuki floats above the ground, and dealing 1 instance of AoE Anemo DMG to nearby opponents.

Dreamdrifter
·While in the Dreamdrifter state, Yumemizuki Mizuki will continuously drift forward, dealing AoE Anemo DMG to nearby opponents at regular intervals.
·During this time, Yumemizuki Mizuki can control her direction of drift, and the pick-up distance of Yumemi Style Special Snacks from the Elemental Burst Anraku Secret Spring Therapy will be increased.
·Increases the Swirl DMG and Stellar Swirl reaction DMG that nearby party members deal based on Yumemizuki Mizuki's Elemental Mastery.
·Dreamdrifter will end when Mizuki leaves the field or uses her Elemental Skill again.

abilities.name: Anraku Secret Spring Therapy

_curatorNotes: tickCap 8, MIRRORING the damage series on this summon (tick-cap round, 2026-08-18): same interval and first delay, so it is one gcsim tick emitting both. The oracle cannot measure a heal, so this rides the damage measurement rather than a reading of its own.

tickCap 8 (tick-cap round, 2026-08-18): gcsim burst.go `for i := int(snackInterval); i <= burstDuration; i += snackInterval` with snackInterval 90 and burstDuration 720 - the bound is INCLUSIVE, so the tick landing exactly on the 12s end fires and our half-open walk dropped it. Measured 8 at both C0 and C6; we derived 7.

abilities.caveat: Each tick mark is one snack, and a snack resolves to either a heal or an explosion, never both. Pickup or explosion can lag the mark by up to 4s.
_curatorNotes: 'grouping' tag added (capability sweep 2026-07-28): kit text — the burst 'pull[s] in nearby objects and opponents'; gcsim burst.go:40 carries the same comment. The pull happens once on the initial cast; tag only, no numeric effect.

Snack ticks (P3): gcsim snackInterval=1.5s starting at burstHitmark (=summon spawn). 8 snacks per 12s Mini Baku duration. Munen damage is the snackDMG multiplier (127.01% ATK Anemo at TL10). The 4s pickup window before auto-explode means actual damage timing differs from the rendered tick by up to 4s — accepted approximation.

Snack heal authored 2026-07-12 (resolves the 'tag without effect' audit finding: burst tagged heal had no heal effect). gcsim mizuki/snack.go onPickedUp(): Heal Src = (mizuki.Stat(EM) * snackHealEM[TL] + snackHealFlat[TL]) * healMultiplier, Target: activeChar.Index(). mizuki_gen.go snackHealEM[9]=2.35008 → scaling 235 (% of EM); snackHealFlat[9]=692.10645 → flat 692. Cross-checks sidecar row 'Snack Pick-Up HP Regeneration' TL10 = '235.0% Elemental Mastery+692'. Authored as target 'active' (gcsim heals the active char = the party member who walks into the snack), scaling 235 stat em + flat 692.

Pickup is not a schema trigger primitive — same known gap as Neuvillette Sourcewater droplets (tier-c-guide 'Pickup-driven empowerment') and the traveler_hydro summon-collectible shape. Modeled on the summon's existing snack-spawn cadence (summonTick 1.5s, firstTickDelay 1.5) as the honest best-fit, mirroring the Diona Drunken Mist / Kuki Grass Ring burst summonTick heal+damage pairs. Unlike those two (which heal AND damage every tick), Mizuki's heal and Munen damage are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE per snack — each spawn becomes one or the other — so the parallel heal+damage markers are two possible outcomes of the same snack, not additive; called out in the caveat.

Two nuances not expressible in the schema, covered by caveat only: (1) the HP<70% gate (gcsim snackHealTriggerHpRatio=0.7) that routes pickup to heal-vs-explode — no per-recipient-HP heal gate primitive; (2) the healMultiplier=2.0 self-double when the active char IS Mizuki (self-pickup heals twice) — no per-recipient-identity heal scaling; authored at base 1×. C4 (Buds Warm Lucid Springs) makes every pickup do BOTH heal and damage + 5 Energy — that constellation branch remains description-only per the C4 node's existing note.

[A7] Heal branch: pickup at HP<70% heals 235% EM + 692 flat (TL10). Explosion branch: pickup at HP>70%, or auto-explode after 4s uncollected, deals 127.01% ATK Anemo. 8 snacks over the 12s summon at a 1.5s spawn cadence. (All already recorded in the burst's existing curator notes.)

↻ CAVEAT TRIMMED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass): kept only the on-screen half. Full prior text: "Each tick mark is one snack, and a snack resolves to either a heal or an explosion, never both. Self-pickup doubles the heal though the base amount is shown, and pickup or explosion can lag the mark by up to 4s."
abilities.description:
Summons forth countless lovely dreams and nightmares that pull in nearby objects and opponents, dealing AoE Anemo DMG and summoning a Mini Baku.

Mini Baku:
Follows the current active character. At regular intervals, the Mini Baku will create 1 Yumemi Style Special Snack nearby. After one of your own party members picks up a Special Snack, if their HP is higher than 70%, the Snack will explode and unleash a Munen Shockwave, dealing 1 instance of AoE Anemo DMG to nearby opponents. Otherwise, it will heal the character who picked it up based on Yumemizuki Mizuki's Elemental Mastery. When Yumemizuki Mizuki triggers healing by picking up a Yumemi Style Special Snack, the amount of healing is increased by 100%. If a Snack is not picked up after a period of time, it will explode and release a Munen Shockwave, dealing 1 instance of AoE Anemo DMG to nearby opponents.

passives.name: Bright Moon's Restless Voice
_curatorNotes: Swirl-triggered Dreamdrifter extension (+2.5s, max 2 extensions, 0.3s ICD) authored on the skill's durationExtensions[] (E3 v1.5, 2026-05-10). ↻ 2026-08-18: this used to send the reader to a skill note about "cast-only emission" — that caveat is retired; see the corrected A1 note on the skill. The extension is driven by the live gauge off Mizuki's own applications, drift-cloud hits included.
passives.description: When Yumemizuki Mizuki triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction while in her Dreamdrifter state, Dreamdrifter's duration increases by 2.5s. This effect can trigger once every 0.3s for a maximum of 2 times per Dreamdrifter state.

passives.name: Thoughts by Day Bring Dreams by Night
_curatorNotes: +100 EM Mizuki for 4s when other party members hit with Pyro/Hydro/Cryo/Electro during Dreamdrifter (0.3s ICD). Modelled as a manual-triggered self buff gated on nightsoulBlessing state — leverages the new opensState mechanism so the buff only fires inside the actual Dreamdrifter window. The element-specific teammate-hit trigger isn't expressible (no elementHit trigger primitive); manual is the closest schema fit.

↻ trigger `manual` → `onCast skill`, 2026-09-16 (T0.5; manual-trigger-retirement step 3). The buff is REAL and was reaching no surface at all; it is now a self bar riding the Dreamdrifter window, with the approximation in the caveat. gcsim asc.go:85-110 is the true shape — subscribe to enemy damage, refuse the holder's own hits (ActorIndex == c.Index()), require the Dreamdrifter status, 0.3s ICD, +100 EM for 4s.

⛔ `onHit` with `source: 'others'` WAS TRIED AND MEASURED WRONG, 2026-09-16 — do not re-reach for it until the engine changes. No buff pool anchors a character's onHit effect on ANOTHER character's hit: the cast pool merges onCast and onHit and anchors both on the HOLDER'S OWN cast without consulting `trigger.source`, and the N/CA/P pools anchor on the holder's own swings. Measured `Yumemizuki Mizuki E Q > Xiangling E N1 N2 N3`: the bar fired off HER E and HER Q — the exact hits the talent excludes — and off none of Xiangling's. Nicole's A4 (`source: 'active'`) behaves the same way and is the corpus's only other character-hosted onHit buff with a non-self source. ⏭ Two engine pieces: a teammate-hit anchor for a character buff pool, and `trigger.source` honoured at the pools that exist.

⚠️ Even with that, the ELEMENT filter has no home: the talent names four elements and `TriggerFilter.element` takes one, so the faithful form would be four effects — and four effects means four independent procCooldown clocks where gcsim holds ONE shared 0.3s ICD (a4ICDKey). `damageType: 'elemental'` is the nearest single-clock form, and in a Mizuki team the excluded cases are rare: she is a Swirl amplifier, so her teammates are Pyro/Hydro/Cryo/Electro by construction.

↻ 2026-09-21 (cross-character onHit round): the engine changed, and this is now the talent as written — `onHit`, `source: 'others'`, the four elements as ONE `filter.element` list (so ONE shared 0.3s `procCooldown`, gcsim's single `a4ICDKey`), 4s refreshing, gated on `inStance` (Dreamdrifter is her only stance) and read at the TEAMMATE's hit. A summon's tick counts: gcsim refuses only `ActorIndex == c.Index()`, and an off-field Oz carries Fischl's. The two ⛔/⚠️ notes above describe the blockers this removed; the caveat went with them, since the bar no longer claims the whole Dreamdrifter window. ⚠️ One residue: gcsim starts the 0.3s ICD BEFORE its element test, so an Anemo/Geo/Dendro/physical teammate hit can eat a window there and cannot here.
passives.description: While Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, when other nearby party members hit opponents with Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, or Electro attacks, her Elemental Mastery will increase by 100 for 4s.

passives.name: Vast Be the Dream
_curatorNotes: ADDED 2026-09-16 (T0.5). Mizuki's Witch's Revelation Passive, unlocked by the world quest "Witch's Revelation: Instruction Beyond Dreams". ⚠️⚠️ Wiki-only evidence, fetched verbatim from the Fandom Talent Infobox (`Vast Be the Dream`, utility tags Additive Base DMG Bonus / Elemental Mastery / Direct Stellar Swirl): genshin-db 5.2.13 carries NO Revelation passive for anyone — `extraPassives` is empty for every holder — so nothing in the ingest pipeline would ever have surfaced it. Same provenance as Wriothesley's and Cyno's.

Authored: the team EM half, verbatim "while Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, the Elemental Mastery of nearby party characters is also increased by 10% of her Elemental Mastery" — ratio 10, since ⚓ `ratio` is per 100 STAT UNITS. It is the only team EM bar she has. Window = the Dreamdrifter stance (onCast skill, 5s), the same span as the skill's own Swirl bonus.

⛔ NOT authored: the enhanced periodic tick (+1,000% of her EM on the next cloud hit after a Swirl, once per 2.5s) and its Radiance twin are damage magnitude; the "Radiance: Stellar Swirl state for 8s when a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl" is a state with no surface and no authored consumer. Neither is a pixel.
passives.description:
When Yumemizuki Mizuki triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction while in the Dreamdrifter state, the next instance of periodic AoE Anemo DMG she deals to nearby enemies during that same state will be increased by 1,000% of her Elemental Mastery. The aforementioned effect can trigger once every 2.5s.
Radiance: Stellar Swirl: When Yumemizuki Mizuki deals to an opponent the above enhanced AoE Anemo DMG, she will also deal an additional instance of Anemo DMG at 1,000% of her Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Stellar Swirl reaction DMG.

Additionally, while Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, the Elemental Mastery of nearby party characters is also increased by 10% of her Elemental Mastery.
Yumemizuki Mizuki will also enter the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state for 8s when a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.

constellations.name: In Mist-Like Waters
_curatorNotes: Twenty-Three Nights' Awaiting: per-enemy debuff applied every 3.5s during Dreamdrifter, lasts 3s. Anemo Swirl on affected enemy: +1,100% EM as bonus DMG. Modelled as a damage effect on swirl reaction gated by nightsoulBlessing state — the per-enemy debuff state isn't gateable, so this fires on any swirl during Dreamdrifter, slightly over-applying. Updated scaling from 100% (existing placeholder) to 1100% per description.

🐛 ↻ 7.0 (genshin-db 5.2.13, 2026-08-31): SPLIT INTO TWO EFFECTS, and this was a live over-claim rather than a prose lag. The Stellar rollout added `stellarSwirl` to the OR-array on 2026-08-31 without noticing that the same patch also SPLIT the value — the kit now reads "increased by 1,100% and 550% of Mizuki's Elemental Mastery, respectively", so a Stellar Swirl was drawing DOUBLE. ⚠️ Authored as two mutually-exclusive effects (base swirls 1,100% · stellarSwirl 550%) rather than one effect with a conditional value: replacement is clean, so exactly one of the two can ever fire for a given reaction event, and a `stellarSwirl` event is never also a `cryoSwirl` event. ⚓ The general lesson: when a 7.0 rename adds a converted reaction to a trigger, re-read the NUMBERS too — of the fifteen revised entries only this one and Sandrone's C4 split their values, and the other thirteen really were renames.
constellations.description: When Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, she will continuously apply the "Twenty-Three Nights' Awaiting" effect to nearby opponents for 3s every 3.5s. When an opponent has a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction triggered against them by Anemo DMG while the aforementioned effect is active, the effect will be canceled, and this Swirl or Stellar Swirl instance deals DMG against this opponent increased by 1,100% and 550% of Mizuki's Elemental Mastery, respectively.

constellations.name: Your Echo I Meet in Dreams
_curatorNotes: Per-EM damage bonus to teammates' Pyro/Hydro/Cryo/Electro DMG during Dreamdrifter (0.04% per EM, no cap mentioned). Not modellable cleanly — the buff is per-element-type and per-EM-point. Removed prior placeholder 0.04 EM stat buff which made no sense (the 0.04 was the per-EM ratio, not a stat value). Description-only.

↻ AUTHORED 2026-09-16 (T0.5). The note above ("Not modellable cleanly — the buff is per-element-type and per-EM-point") predates the `scaling` BuffValue being used for exactly this shape (Varka A1, Cryo Traveler A4): 0.04% per EM point is ratio 4, since ⚓ `ratio` is per 100 STAT UNITS. Four effects because the constellation names four DMG Bonus stats and each is its own Stat key — they share a trigger and a span, so they pool into one row. The window is the Dreamdrifter stance (onCast skill, 5s), which is what "until the Dreamdrifter state ends" means; the A1 extension moves the stance, not this.
constellations.description: When Yumemizuki Mizuki enters the Dreamdrifter state, every Elemental Mastery point she has will increase all nearby party members' Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, and Electro DMG Bonuses by 0.04% until the Dreamdrifter state ends.

constellations.name: The Heart Lingers Long
_curatorNotes: Swirl can crit during Dreamdrifter: CR fixed 30%, CDmg fixed 100%. Schema doesn't have per-reaction crit overrides; Swirl in our model isn't subject to crit at all. Description-only.

↻ 7.0 (genshin-db 5.2.13, 2026-08-31): gained a second clause — Stellar Swirl DMG from those characters also gets +10% CRIT Rate and +20% CRIT DMG. Still description-only for the same reason as the first clause: the schema has no per-reaction crit override and Swirl is not subject to crit in our model at all.
constellations.description: While Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, Swirl reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members can score CRIT Hits, with CRIT Rate fixed at 30%, and CRIT DMG fixed at 100%. Any Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by these characters will also have its CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG increased by 10% and 20%, respectively.

notModeled.reason: The Rotation Planner doesn't draw damage amounts, and this only lets Swirl damage land critical hits.

_curatorNotes: ↻ 7.0 (genshin-db 5.2.13, 2026-08-31): kit text rewritten from "Swirl" to "Swirl or Stellar Swirl", so `stellarSwirl` joins the trigger. ⚓ Needed because a Stellar Swirl enabler (Sandrone/Odette/Cryo Traveler) REPLACES every Cryo Swirl party-wide — without this the effect would go dark in those teams. ⛔ Only added where HoYo actually renamed the text: a buff on the base reaction is NOT a buff on the converted one, so characters whose text was left alone (Venti, Lohen) stay as-is.
